III.A); also "fewer than 2×10^4 optimization steps" for the Table II results. || route2b-pass 2026-09-24: parameters = M x N x Q x d x d = 128 x 112 x 5 x 4 x 4 = 1146880 (M = 128 sites, N = 112 electrons at n = 0.875, Q = 5 for NN backflow per Table 5, d = 4 local states). The formula reproduces the three counts the paper prints (286,720 and 3,670,016 on 64 sites, 4,587,520 on 16x16 NN), which also fixes d = 4. The count is lattice-size dependent (grows as M x N). The UHF-extended layout g[r_i, k sigma_k, sigma_i, 2, j, s(r_j)] used for direct optimization has the same product (16 M N Q). The p = 1 row has the same tensor; its Lanczos step (O(N^4 Q) per amplitude, O(N^5 Q) for the variance) is not counted by nqs-v1. Only the N x N x Q entries selected by a configuration are read per amplitude (62720 here), so the ARCH 'Tensor backflow' reuse = 1 overcounts the forward pass by M d^2 / N = 18.3x. || pass 2026-09-27: reuse = entries a configuration reads / parameters = (N_e x N_e x Q) / (M x N_e x Q x d^2) = N_e / (M d^2) = 112 / (128 x 16) = 0.0546875 (so 2 x P x reuse = 2 N_e^2 Q = 125440, one read-and-add per entry; P = M N_e Q d^2 = 1146880, Q = 5 NN backflow, d = 4). Each of the N_e occupied rows sums Q entries for each of the N_e orbitals (Eq. 6), the determinant dominates: the forward was 3.0x (8x16) to 2.1x (256 sites) over with reuse 1 (verify/VERIFY.md Part 2 #16, agent-C.md §3). sr none: first-order gradient optimisation. Not set, and why: proposals_per_sample (the only interval stated, "twice as the lattice size" = 2M, is for the Fig. 8 correlation measurements, not the optimisation sampler; agent-C.md used it for k, 2x the default) and local_energy (how zero hops are treated is not stated). Samples O(4.5e4) and iterations (< 2e4) are an order of magnitude and a bound (DOUBTFUL, unchanged).
